name: Viewing Direction Gaussian Splatting
definition: A hybrid rendering model that uses 3D Gaussian distributions to represent the 3D object's shape (position, covariance) and a neural network to encode color and opacity based on viewing direction.
summary: Viewing Direction Gaussian Splatting combines 3D Gaussian Splatting with a neural network to modulate opacity based on viewing direction, enabling accurate specular reflections and transparency while maintaining fast training and inference speeds.
